name: @wxyc/flowsheet-ghost-row-sweep
description: One-shot dry-run-by-default sweep (BS#1887): anti-join flowsheet.legacy_entry_id / rotation.legacy_rotation_id against a pluggable authoritative keyspace source and DELETE the orphans (ghost rows left behind by the upsert-only tubafrenzy ETLs, BS#1083). File-backed LegacyKeyspaceSource for tests today; the prod dump adapter and the actual prod run are BS#1083 / BS#1543. Batched DELETE + ANALYZE-after per the bulk-update playbook, id-cursor resume, cooperative pause, SIGTERM graceful stop.
